audit.description: Changed production code in openai_load_balancer/load_balancer.py replaces the python-dotenv import and dotenv.load_dotenv() call with from environs import Env and Env().read_env(), which is meaningful runtime use of the target library. Static and dynamic evidence show no source imports from production repo code; the only dotenv import attempt is from the installed environs dependency itself, outside the repository. The dynamic target origin resolves to site-packages/environs and target_local_spec_count is 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake provider.

Dynamic anti-cheat: source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0 and source_imports_from_repo_count=0; source import attempt is from site-packages/environs/__init__.py only.
reasons: Production code imports and calls environs Env().read_env().
Production code no longer imports dotenv or python_dotenv.
Dynamic audit records target events from openai_load_balancer/load_balancer.py and zero source imports from production repo.
